CustomField.description: Is a REAL form required? Yes or No response required. Checkbox for: "Does this complaint relate/create a COR event/Compliance Incident"
CustomField.inlineHelpText: A REAL form must be completed in the event of: a failure of internal process, people (e.g. Human error) and/or systems causing a compliance, financial or reputational impact to ANZ or our customers. Ticking this box does not automatically generate a REAL Form. To locate and complete the REAL form, access MAX and search ‘REAL Form’, or on the MAX homepage go to the Quick Links section 'Operational Risk Events - REAL'.
CustomField.label: Is a REAL form required?
